params.body:
Shane, with the live screen open: "ik vind de inhoud nog niet optimaal". What it showed:

```
[rood]  stocklist:smoke --all is mislukt.
[amber] 20 wagens werden de voorbije 7 dagen door een partner geweigerd.
```

Both true, both over.

The smoke test failed at 06:30. The fix was merged and deployed hours earlier and the round had been run green by hand (`EXIT=0`), but a task keeps its last outcome until it runs again, which is tomorrow morning. So the line read exactly like a task breaking right now.

The twenty refusals were all Nederland Mobiel, last one on 21 September: resolved, three days old, and amber for four more days because the window is seven.

## State and event are not the same thing

A failing task is a **state**. It belongs in the verdict until it runs again, but it says how long ago it failed.

A refusal is an **event**. It belongs in the verdict while the last one is of today, and after that it drops to the quiet line in the partner section, where a seven-day window is exactly right.

```
[rood]  stocklist:smoke --all is mislukt, 6 u geleden.
[amber] nederlandmobiel weigerde 20 van 254 oproepen, laatste 2 u geleden.
```

Same facts, and you can see whether it is still running or history.

This is the same mistake as the photo flags this morning (R P3-14.6): not the number was wrong, the number carried no age. A verdict that reads the same yesterday and now teaches you to skip it, and then the whole layer is gone.

## What moved

`Operations::partners()` also reports `calls`, `worst` and `last_refused`, so the line can name the partner and the ratio instead of only a count. `Operations::within()` holds the boundary, away from the screen, so a test can pin it without rendering anything.

Two existing tests were rewritten onto their own point rather than the old wording: `OperationsScreenTest` built the full sentence itself, and `ARefusalFromAPartnerIsVisibleTest` matched on the word "geweigerd", which the new line does not use. Both now check the partner's name, which is what they were really about.

## Verified

`TheVerdictKnowsWhenTest`: a refusal of today is in the verdict and names the partner, one of three days ago is not while the partner section still counts it, and the boundary is a day.

Full suite: 2.132 tests, with only the two known `ListPageHeadersTest` cases failing, which fail the same way without this change because those tables are empty in my local database. `phpstan` green over the whole project; `pint` green on the added file.

Rule R P3-14.12. Fixes bevinding het-oordeel-had-geen-besef-van-tijd.
params.title: The verdict says when, not only how many
